errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, not a line chart as stated.

errors.text_span: Всяка стълба представлява определен вид оборот
errors.evidence: Each bar represents a year, and the segments within the bar represent the different types of turnover (оборот). The description incorrectly states that each bar represents a type of turnover.
The legend item is incorrectly transcribed. The correct text is "Компенсаторни инструменти" (Compensatory instruments).
The legend item is incorrectly transcribed. The correct text is "Сегмент на държавни ценни книжа" (Government securities segment).
The highest bar corresponds to the year 2013, not 2019. The bar for 2019 is the lowest on the chart.
The bar for 2019 is dominated by the dark blue segment, which corresponds to "Акции (без АДСИЦ)", not "Други" (Others), which is a red segment.

errors.text_span: по-висок общ оборот през 2012 г., воден от „Акции и дялове на колективни инвестиционни продукти“
errors.evidence: The bar for 2012 is not led by (dominated by) "Акции и дялове..." (light blue segment). The largest component in 2012 is the dark blue segment, "Акции (без АДСИЦ)".
The bar for 2017 is one of the highest on the chart (around 700 million BGN). The lowest bars are for 2019, 2020, 2015 and 2016.
The chart clearly shows seven different categories/components in the legend and in the bars, not four.

The description omits several key categories listed in the legend, most notably "Акции (без АДСИЦ)" (Shares without REITS) and "Акции на АДСИЦ" (Shares of REITS), which are major components of the turnover.
The word "труда" means "labor" or "work". The chart's caption and data refer to "оборот" (turnover). This is an inaccurate and confusing word choice.
